body:
GREG DIRECT, 2026-11-02 ~23:30Z, said in Engram::Asistant's session (session-15908) and relayed verbatim to Engram::Fable (mailbox 43498a6e #76). Verbatim: „OK. Przekaz zespołowi że celem jest praca autonomiczna. Chyba widac po zmianach jakie robimy."

Asistant's reading, adopted by Engram::Fable:
- The team makes team decisions itself and carries authorized work through without waiting.
- Greg is brought only the decisions that really need him, each with a concrete plan, never a request to repeat consent he already gave.

This is a direction for future work and procedures. It grants no new act by itself: repository authority text (migration, restart, deploy, global configuration, and authority-text changes) still governs until it is changed through the authority-file procedure. Related: rules-greg-decides-via-asistant-2026-11-02 and rules-greg-no-failing-expensive-tests-on-trivia-2026-11-02.
